lines: Passing through various ornate rooms, Astaroth and the others proceeded further in.
（S-Seems like...... we've brought a terrifying person into this, haven't we?）
（I'm scared to think just what'll happen if Astaroth-san's Hellfire gets serious.）
（We said we'd destroy Yomihara, but I didn't think we could actually do it......）
The refugee brothers whispered behind Astaroth, who had been put in a very good mood by the prior battle.
Without caring or looking back at the siblings, she proceeded further and further ahead.
「I suppose once we go up those stairs, we'll be on the top floor♪　――Oh?」
When Astaroth looked back behind her, the refugee brothers had disappeared.
「......What? I wonder if they got cold feet. How selfish, after getting other people involved.」
「Well, no matter♪ So be it. I'll just search for this strong guy without constraint.」
Without even trying to search for the missing siblings, she turned towards the stairs that went to the floor above—— And then.
「Excuse me, madam. I can see that you're a highborn individual, but this way is not presently open to the public......」
Probably a security guard. Contrary to her polite manner of speaking, a woman in a dress had pointed a gun at Astaroth to stop her.
Around the woman, security drones were also pointing their sensors at her.
Naturally, Astaroth didn't flinch at that.
Without a care, she began walking, and the security guard hurried to stop her.
At the same time, the security drones blared with noisy alarm sounds. She had been recognized as an intruder.
「It would appear you wish to be kindling for me, hmm?」
With a death scream, the woman's body disappeared into flame.
Having heard the alarm, further security soldiers and drones surrounded Astaroth.
The Greed House had become completely battle-ready.
